title: UALink completer on the UPLI: READ, WRITE, FETCH_ADD, SWAP and CAS to a small memory over the request, originator data, read response and write response channels, each credited

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a response with a non-OK status: UR (the access runs past the memory) or BAD (invalid command, misaligned address, atomic with len != 0)

irqs.name: PROTO
irqs.desc: a request or data beat without a credit (dropped), an od_last not matching the beat count, or a response credit past 15

notes: req_*, od_*, rd_* and wr_* are the UPLI request, originator data, read response and write response channels to the originator; they pass through unchanged. The registers report the completer's error events.
The core parameters MW (16), RQ (4) and DQ (8) keep their defaults.
